تحتوشون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَوِشُونَ (taḥtawišūna) /taħ.ta.wi.ʃuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# تُحْتَوَشُونَ (tuḥtawašūna) /tuħ.ta.wa.ʃuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
